propositions: The eval/calibration library excludes activated project code-review criteria because `_code_review_prompt_id` only admits static built-in physical ids without repository context.
The `calibrate_criterion` function maps non-physical ids through the plan-review namespace and lacks a code-review membership branch.
`_code_review_prompt_id` must accept an optional `repo_root` parameter to add every logical id from `code_review.registry.effective_criteria(repo_root)` to the admission set.

When `calibrate_criterion` receives a non-None `repo_root` and the criterion id is active in code-review registry, it must resolve the criterion through the code-review arm instead of the plan-review branch.
An active project code-review criterion with no eval spec must raise a located `EvalError` containing the logical criterion id and the eval-spec path.
